shows.title: Room on the Broom Live On Stage
shows.description: Jump on board the broom with the witch and her cat in Tall Stories’ fun-filled adaptation of Room on the Broom, the much-loved picture book by Julia Donaldson and Axel Scheffler.

shows.title: An Oak Tree
shows.description: Tim Crouch's groundbreaking An Oak Tree returns to London this autumn. A bereaved father comes face to face with the stage hypnotist involved in his daughter's death in a funny, moving and utterly unique theatrical event. Featuring a different guest co-star every performance.

shows.title: Feeling Afraid As If Something Terrible Is Going To Happen
shows.description: This razor-sharp dark comedy follows a stand-up comic whose perfect romance spirals into obsession, deception and killer punchlines.
